# Postcard

> A skill for coding agents. It finds and compares travel (flights, trains, buses, ferries, drives) with real prices read in a browser, shows the options on an engraved map page, and books the pick up to the payment page. The person pays.

You get here when a person asks you to install postcard, or to plan a trip with it. Install the skill when you can. Without a file system or a shell, use the short guide below.

## Install the skill (preferred)

Pick the first one that works:

- Any agent with the skills CLI: `npx skills add henrikkvamme/postcard`
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add henrikkvamme/postcard`, then `/plugin install postcard@postcard`
- Any agent with a skills folder: download https://postcard.henrikkvamme.no/postcard-skill.tar.gz and unpack it there, so the folder is `<skills>/postcard/SKILL.md`.

Then read `SKILL.md` in the installed folder and follow it for the person's request. It needs Python 3 (standard library only) and a browser tool.

## Without the skill

When you cannot install files, do the same work by hand:

1. Brief: find out from where, to where, the dates, the reason (an event, a holiday), what matters (price, time, comfort), passengers and bags. Ask only what you cannot find.
2. Search: read real journeys and prices in a browser, every mode that makes sense, every seller you see, with the date you saw each price and the bag terms. Do not solve captchas; use another source.
3. Write one trip.json in the format of https://postcard.henrikkvamme.no/skill/references/trip-schema.md. Facts only. Mark every value you did not read as an estimate.
4. Show it: give the person https://postcard.henrikkvamme.no/view and the file to drop there, or a link `https://postcard.henrikkvamme.no/view#trip=<public URL of trip.json>`. The host of that URL must allow other sites to read it (CORS), as a GitHub gist raw link does. The viewer draws the trip in their browser and stores nothing.
5. Book: when the person picks, the viewer gives them a request to paste back to you. Fill each booking in their browser and stop on the payment page. Never pay and never type card details.

## Rules

- Real prices only. Every price has a seller, a source and the date you saw it.
- Say what you did not check (a bag fee, a seat class) next to the figure it changes.
- Stop on the payment page, every time.
- Keep personal data (names, booking references) out of trip.json.
